propositions: Plan assertions about module capability presence/absence must be validated against actual code surface; false assertions lead to plans building unavailable capabilities or redundantly rebuilding existing ones
The probe detects two symmetric failure modes: (A) plan claims module M provides capability C but code lacks it, (B) plan claims capability must be built but module already provides it

Criterion is implemented as advisory code-grounding criterion in the existing four-pass (finder/verifier/decide/coach) machinery with AGENT-tier execution and packaged as a non-orphan built-in LLM criterion
Advisory posture means the criterion never blocks reviews; promotion to blocking status is gated on future dogfood metrics via the standing criterion-effectiveness recorder
Bounded sanity check validates the probe fires on >=2 of 3 reconstructed E1-verified miss cases (dc58, db7b, 5886) and does not block on clean plans

Criterion registration, routing configuration, rubric prompt, and guide documentation are complete and pass validation; auto-inclusion in standing effectiveness recorder requires zero per-criterion wiring
